content.rendered:
No matter why you’re saving, we have a plan

Effective saving is about planning ahead. Whether you’re looking ahead to retirement, planning for your child’s or your own education or any other milestone, you need a partner with the skills and resources to get you there. We can provide you with the savings vehicles that can set you up for financial security.

Open an account

Whether in-person or online, a Nebula Trust team member can help customize your banking experience to your needs and guide you through account-opening. 

OPEN AN ACCOUNT

It’s like anything — you can all have the great tools, but if you don’t have the people backing it up, it’s not worth anything and Chelsea’s got great people.
– Peter

CDs & IRAs

Let’s build a savings plan that works for you.

EXPLORE CDs & IRAs

Savings, HSAs & Money Markets

No matter what you’re saving for, Nebula Trust has a product and a plan for you.

EXPLORE SAVINGS, HSAs & MONEY MARKETS

Education planning

Every student’s journey is unique and we keep that in mind when helping you plan for college savings.

SAVE FOR EDUCATION

Frequently Asked Questions

Yes, changing to a Statement Savings account will provide you with ATM card access and access to your account information through online banking. Monthly statements are provided to you and you can have the option of eStatements through Online Banking.
